title: thelypteris limaensis
intro: Thelypteris limaensis, commonly known as Lima Fern, is a species of fern found in the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and oxidative stress, which may contribute to the prevention of certain diseases such as cancer and Alzheimer's. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris limaensis are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
